- [USER] User inquired about colleges that are good for technical product manager jobs.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] There are many colleges that can provide excellent education for students who want to pursue a career in technical product management.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] List of top 20 colleges in no particular order that are good for technical product management jobs:

  2. Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT)
  3. University of California, Berkeley
  4. Carnegie Mellon University
  5. University of Washington
  6. University of Texas at Austin
  7. Georgia Institute of Technology
  8. University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign

  10. California Institute of Technology (Caltech)
  11. University of California, San Diego
  12. University of Southern California (USC)
  13. University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA)
  14. Cornell University
  15. Northwestern University
  16. University of Pennsylvania
  17. Columbia University
  18. Harvard University
  19. Yale University
  20. Duke University
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Note that while attending one of these schools can provide a strong foundation for a career in technical product management, it is not a guarantee of success.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Success in this field requires a combination of technical and business skills, as well as experience and a strong network.
